title: Microsoft.Testing.Platform extension manifest
description: Declares extensions that Microsoft.Testing.Platform loads dynamically at start-up. The file name must end with '.testingplatformextensions.json' and the file must sit next to the test application. See https://github.com/microsoft/testfx/blob/main/docs/RFCs/023-Dynamic-Extension-Loading.md.

$schema.description: The URI of this JSON schema.

extensions.description: The extensions to load, in the order in which their hooks are invoked.

assemblyPath.description: Path to the assembly containing the hook type. A relative path is resolved against the directory of this manifest.

typeFullName.description: Full name of the type declaring the static 'AddExtensions(ITestApplicationBuilder, string[])' hook.

id.description: Stable identifier used to de-duplicate the same extension declared by several manifests. Compared ordinally and case-insensitively. Defaults to the resolved assembly path combined with the type full name.

displayName.description: Human-readable name used in diagnostics. Defaults to the type full name.

enabled.description: Whether the extension is loaded. Set to false to keep the declaration in place without loading it.
